Emotions are trying to tell us something. Pushing them away may bring short-term relief, but in the long run it adds to the load.

## Noticing

Pausing for a moment during the day to ask "What am I feeling right now?" is a small but powerful step.

## Naming

Giving an emotion a name puts a little distance between you and it, and makes choosing easier.
